title: Convention profile
description: A convention profile (definitions/profiles/<id>.yml): the set of requirements that applies to one kind of repository, and the severity each is reported at. A consuming repository names its profile in .repo/conventions.yaml.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

id.description: The profile's identifier; matches its filename.

description.description: Which repositories the profile is for.

inherits.description: Profiles whose selections and severities this one starts from. Cycles are rejected.

include.description: Requirements to select, by family, by convention, or by ID. A requirement matching any list is selected.

exclude.description: Requirements removed from the selection, whichever include (or inherited profile) selected them.

include_proposed.description: Whether selected requirements with status proposed apply. Unset inherits the value from the profiles this one inherits (true if any of them sets it); the default is false. Retired requirements never apply.

severity.description: Severity overrides by requirement ID. An override may only raise a requirement's severity (warning to error), never lower it, and may only name a selected requirement.
